name: ZoomOSC
author: Control It Team
subtitle: Video Conferencing & Meeting Automation
descriptionText: Control Zoom meetings, pin/spotlight participants, manage gallery views, mute participants, and send in-meeting commands via ZoomOSC.

setupFields.label: ZoomOSC Host / IP
setupFields.helpText: Enter IP address of computer running ZoomOSC.

variables.name: All Participants Muted
variables.descriptionText: Whether meeting audio is globally muted

actions.title: ZoomOSC: Mute All Participants
actions.subtitle: Mute everyone in meeting
actions.descriptionText: Sends command to mute all meeting attendees.

actions.title: ZoomOSC: Ask All to Unmute
actions.subtitle: Prompt participants to unmute
actions.descriptionText: Sends an unmute request prompt to all participants.

actions.title: ZoomOSC: Toggle Raise Hand
actions.subtitle: Raise or lower host hand
actions.descriptionText: Toggles host raise hand status in meeting.

actions.title: ZoomOSC: Get Meeting Status
actions.subtitle: Query mute & hand raise status
actions.descriptionText: Queries meeting participant audio mute status and hand raise state.
